roles.observedBasis: Morsure : Court vers le pied et mord.

method.engine: Unmodified FightEngine.update/render with native Canvas drawImage observed after the real draw.
method.input: Only original registered InputState keydown/keyup callbacks receive synthetic events. No writes to actors, input sets, clocks, phase, facing, positions, health or attacks.
method.cadence: An ordinary 12-tick movement uses existing static walk frame3. Keyup changes the real pose to idle and naturally resets its clock to zero; 48 successive updates/renders observe two complete cycles.
method.orientations: Separate local duels put Air Screamer in its ordinary player1/player2 spawn. No teleport, actor swap or facing assignment.
method.alignment: SHA-bound manually reviewed anatomical landmarks are projected through observed drawImage arguments/matrices. Wing extents are not body landmarks.
method.decoder: Source PNG bytes are verified. Sharp normalizes PNG encoding in memory only, with exact decoded RGBA comparison.

limits: Native Canvas is not browser/DOM/HTTP/actual physical keyboard validation.
Idle cadence is authored versus timing, not certified timing from the original game. walk[3] is one retained static image, not a multi-frame animation.
Landmarks are manually selected silhouette points and their projection cannot certify canonical anatomy or hidden geometry.
The six named idle pose captures still require manual review for cropping, identity, angle and apparent body stability.
No attack/contact/guard/finisher behavior, role changes or one-to-one fidelity are asserted.

landmarkEvidence.method: Same anatomical landmarks at alpha>=96 inside fixed manually reviewed head and foot regions; no image modification. Skull and feet are outline landmarks, not wing extents. Common renderer anchor/scale will remain identical for all three frames. Corrected frame2 measured with the same regions and threshold; rows0/1 unchanged. One common anchorY=.745 is used for all three images; only rendering metadata changes, never native pixels.

cataloguePolicy: Global catalogues are hashed before/after this run. Later unrelated imports require exact tested entry/module hashes for evidence aggregation.
